text: うるせえ　メガネの　ねえちゃんだな　おれらの　じゃま　すんな！

structure.jp: うるせえ　メガネの　ねえちゃんだな
structure.en: what an annoying lady with glasses

structure.jp: おれらの　じゃま　すんな！

patterns.name: 〜な (prohibition)
patterns.explanation: な after a plain verb is a rough 'don't'. すんな is the slurred form of するな. じゃま　すんな = 'don't get in the way'.

patterns.name: 〜だな
patterns.explanation: だな at the end gives the speaker's own impression, like 'what a ...'. Here it follows rough speech, where うるせえ is the slurred うるさい. ねえちゃんだな = 'what a lady she is'.
